plaatsen.tekst: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked
And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh
And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak
This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
